methods.surface: Uniform area samples in each direction; proper labeled-landmark rigid fits, and a separately reported fitted atlas scale. RMS/P95/max are sampled distances, not exact Hausdorff bounds. Coordinate units are input mesh units.
methods.fidelity: Per-backend resampled vertices and triangle interiors to its aligned original mesh; reverse surface coverage distance; source-texture versus baked color at the nearest original surface location. Projection and baking are measured together.
methods.landmarks: Project atlas landmarks to atlas triangles, carry barycentric weights to each resampled specimen, and compare with its aligned input landmarks. In-sample residuals include atlas landmark-to-surface offsets; landmarks also drive fitting.
methods.color: Bilinear premultiplied-alpha sampling at Blender pixel centers; both alpha >= 0.99; encoded sRGB channel errors on 0–255 and Euclidean CIELAB Delta E 76. Coverage counts retained. Cross-backend matching is nearest spatial surface, not proven anatomical correspondence.
methods.pca: Pairwise Euclidean distances between specimen scores; descriptive because atlas sampling/feature spaces differ. No cross-backend scientific ground truth is available.
